summary: Expose conversation admission, exact or roster owner resolution, and first-page timings while proving named-agent reads avoid roster reversal

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery changes.

schema.detail: No database changes or new indexes. Per-store roster counters exist only in tests and use runtime atomics.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing performance tables gain static conversation stage labels with no subject or session identifiers. Public client and peer JSON contracts, permissions, and session IDs are unchanged; hinted timeline pagination retains the owner's cursor snapshot.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No configuration changes or re-pairing required. Existing performance telemetry exposes the stage timings for canary diagnosis.

recovery.detail: No persistent state change or new binary swap-back restriction.
